what: Measured facts about the official PV of MIMI「トリックハート」feat. 重音テトSV (illustration/animation 3774.). Timing data only — no images, no lyrics.

sourceVideo.note: Obtain the PV yourself. These numbers were measured on a 1920x1080, 24/1 fps, 3768-frame, 157.0 s H.264 file with AAC 48 kHz stereo (157.013 s). Verify your copy before reusing frame numbers.

sourceRoles.magician: drill twin-tails, top hat with feather, red blazer, white gloves with orange cuffs, black shorts, asymmetric legwear (own right: striped over-knee; own left: knee sock + separate thigh garter), red boots with white sawtooth cuffs, cheek heart mark
sourceRoles.casual: hair down, oversized grey hoodie/cardigan over yellow top, orange-yellow shoes; from f3543 changes to yellow jacket + crossbody bag, and from f3584 has drill hair tied with a white feather

boilSummary: Most held shots alternate two redraws (A/B) of the whole picture every 6 frames; line displacement between redraws ~1.3-3.2 px median at 1080p. Some shots differ (independent layer clocks, extra redraws) — always use per-shot data.
